root_cause: The observed agreement of 0.9357 exceeds the quality threshold of 0.85, and the only executed experiment (EXP_001) tested a spatial shift of (dr=2, dc=2), which decreased agreement to 0.9299, providing no support for spatial misalignment at that shift. No evidence of data corruption, systematic bias, or other fault was found.
remaining_uncertainty: Only a single shift (dr=2, dc=2) was tested; other shifts were not evaluated, so spatial misalignment at other offsets is not fully ruled out.
Pixel-difference distribution and bias-correction analyses were not performed, leaving H002 and H004 not directly tested.
